change: Collect the project callable and State generic-name set once per immutable aggregate-resolution call. All per-module resolvers borrow it; standalone resolution collects its original local set.
invariants: The old set was the union of current core names and every project core name. Every current core is a clone of a member of that same project, so project-only collection has exactly the same members and cardinality.
All consumers use membership or cardinality only; no iteration order, active binding metadata or callable mode is substituted.
Project aggregate/enum declaration loops, duplicate errors, owner identities, every logical budget charge and per-module resolution order remain unchanged.
A fresh set is collected for each resolve_program invocation, including separate calls before and after closure inference. No cross-request or cross-phase cache.
No public API/schema, source language, ABI, Verify, runtime representation or cache identity change.
